 Singapore's iconic contractor returns in Shopee's latest 11.11 commercial as the platform rolls out over 600 deals at up to 90% off, star-studded livestreams and more ways for shoppers to save and win. 
 SINGAPORE – Media OutReach Newswire – 29 October 2026 – Don't play play! Singapore's favourite contractor, Phua Chu Kang, is back, and Shopee is pulling out all the stops for its 11.11 Big Sale ! Running from 30 October to 17 November, the campaign brings shoppers Shopee's Lowest Prices of the Year and Biggest Vouchers of the Year, with S$111 off S$350 Flash Vouchers, over 600 specially discounted deals and prices starting from just S$0.99.
